name: Secret read + KMS decryption (positive)
note: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue retrieves stored secret material and fires DATA-EXFIL. kms:Decrypt is a DISTINCT decryption capability (IAM-103): it decrypts caller-supplied ciphertext for usable keys, it does NOT enumerate or retrieve secrets, so it fires its own KMS-DECRYPT finding and is not lumped with Secrets Manager. Scoped resources isolate both from WILDCARD-RESOURCE.
